userdoc.notice: The OndoRegistry serves as both a repository for user IDs and a whitelist         for users who are allowed to interact with the RWAManagers. IDs are stored on a per-RWA         and per-user basis, and a single ID can be associated with multiple user addresses. IDs         may be set by the RWA token admin or a master configurer. A master configurer can set         IDs for any RWA token, while an RWA token admin can only set IDs for a specific RWA         token. RWA token admin roles are generated dynamically as needed via the keccak256         hash of the RWA token address.
